name: Felt & Steam
description: Window seats, milk tea and felt cushions. Quiet before noon.

name: Blue Sky Books & Tea
description: A bookshop with armchairs. Easy to talk, easy to leave.

name: Grandmother's Buuz
description: Bright, busy and cheap. Steamed buuz all day.

name: Copper Grill
description: An open kitchen and long tables. Book a table on Fridays.

name: Tuul Riverside Walk
address: Tuul River path, by the Zaisan bridge
description: Willows, benches and a flat path. Best at golden hour.

name: Hilltop Lookout
description: The whole city below. Go at dusk, bring a scarf.

name: Moon Hall Jazz
description: Live jazz from eight. Candles on every table.

name: The Round Lounge
description: A lounge built like a great ger. Low sofas, soft music.

name: Strike Lanes
description: Bowling and table games. Something to do with your hands.

name: Little Picture House
description: One small screen and good popcorn. Old films on Sundays.

name: Square Ice Rink
description: Skates to rent. String lights after dark.

name: White Wall Gallery
description: New painters every month. Free on Thursdays.

name: Horsehead Fiddle Room
description: A small wooden hall. Morin khuur and long song most evenings.

name: Garden Tea Pavilion
description: Tea under the trees in summer, by the stove in winter.

name: Pine Hill Café
description: Big windows onto the pines. Cinnamon buns at noon.
